attributes.action: Get all the illigal immigrants out of the UK or we the British people will do it
attributes.additional_details: We want the UK government to act now and stop all illegal immigrants into the UK.Deport immediately all illegal immigrants here in the UK.No more sons or daughters raped or murdered on our shores.
attributes.background: The UK government must act now and stop all illegal immigrants into the UK.Deport all illegal immigrants here inside the UK or we,the British people will do it instead.
